title: XRaySentinel
description: Detects suspicious ore mining patterns and alerts staff.
body:
# XRaySentinel

Detects suspicious ore mining patterns and alerts staff.

## Features
- Tracks ore vs stone ratios over a rolling window.
- Alerts staff on suspicious mining patterns.
- Configurable thresholds and cooldowns.
- Lightweight memory-only tracking.

## Command
- `/xraysentinel stats <player> | reset <player> | reload`

## Permissions
- `xraysentinel.alert`
- `xraysentinel.admin`

## Config (snippet)
```yml
window-minutes: 10
alert-ratio: 0.20
min-valuable: 3
```

## Compatibility
- Server: Paper, Spigot, Purpur
- Minecraft: 1.16.5 - 1.21.4
